# Catppuccin Frappé

Private accepted-unpublished declarative Theme package for `org.catppuccin.frappe@1.0.0`.

Its inert color tokens are adapted from Catppuccin Palette 1.8.0 at revision
`07d02aa110ef9eb7e7427afca5c73ba9cf7f8ebd`. Catppuccin is MIT licensed; palette authorship
and marks remain with their respective owners. This package is not publicly installable and is not
claimed as an official Catppuccin port.
